about: The envelope every pulse event line carries. One JSON object per line, UTF-8, newline-terminated. Vendored verbatim into each emitting repo; keep the copies identical (umbrella CI compares hashes). Additive only: fields are added, never renamed or removed.

types.integer: a JSON number that is a whole number >= 0
types.uuid: a string in RFC 4122 text form: 8-4-4-4-12 lowercase or uppercase hex digits
types.timestamp: a string in RFC 3339 form with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm); emitters write UTC as +00:00
types.name: a string matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$
types.origin: the string "operator" (a person at the keyboard), "agent" (written by an agent of this stack) or "external" (entered from outside: web pages, search results, text written by third parties)

rules: A line that is not a JSON object is invalid.
A required field that is missing, null, or of the wrong type makes the line invalid.
An optional field that is null counts as absent. One of the wrong type makes the line invalid.
Unknown top-level fields are kept, never rejected, and never dropped (skip and retain).
Unknown kinds are kept. The catalog describes kinds; it does not gate them.

origin describes where the content of this event came from, not where it ran (sandbox and network lane are provenance, recorded on the context row). An absent origin means unknown: exports treat it like external unless a filter opts it in.
